node.statement: Using validated nodes 1.1, 1.2, and 1.2.1: for every n and X, ||v_n(X)||_n=||X tensor I_A||_n=||X|| ||I_A||. Since 1-epsilon<=||I_A||<=1+epsilon and epsilon<=t, we get (1-2t)||X||<=||v_n(X)||_n<=(1+2t)||X|| (indeed the stronger bounds with 1+-epsilon). Node 1.2 supplies linearity, dagger preservation, unitality, and product defect <=2epsilon||X||||Y||<=2t||X||||Y||. Thus every amplification is a 2t-homomorphism with the required two-sided norm bounds, so v is an extended 2t-inclusion by def-extended-delta-inclusion.
